[!exec:llvm-profdata] skip 'requires llvm-profdata compatible with the GoALLC LLVM version'
[short] skip 'builds and runs instrumented and profile-optimized programs'

# Keep the Go frontend profile fixed across training and use.
cp $GOROOT/src/cmd/compile/internal/test/testdata/pgo/inline/inline_hot.pprof cpu.pprof
go build -pgo=cpu.pprof -llvmpgo=generate -o train.exe .
env LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=$WORK/run.proftext
exec ./train.exe
stderr '^5350$'
exec llvm-profdata merge $WORK/run.proftext -o run.profdata
exec llvm-profdata show -function=main.branch -counts run.profdata
stdout 'main.branch:'
go build -x -pgo=cpu.pprof -llvmpgo=run.profdata -o app.exe .
stderr 'compile.*-llvm-pgo=.*-pgoprofile=.*hot.go'
exec ./app.exe
stderr '^5350$'

# Check LLVM consumed the measured counts in the package pipeline.
go tool compile -p main -llvm-pgo=run.profdata -llvm-keep-ir -o check.o hot.go
grep '"function_entry_count", i64 100' check.o.opt.ll
grep '"branch_weights", i32 100, i32 0' check.o.opt.ll

# Replacing a profile at the same path reverses the trained branch.
exec ./train.exe reverse
stderr '^-5550$'
exec llvm-profdata merge $WORK/run.proftext -o run.profdata
go build -x -pgo=cpu.pprof -llvmpgo=run.profdata -o app.exe .
stderr 'compile.*-llvm-pgo=.*hot.go'
go build -x -pgo=cpu.pprof -llvmpgo=run.profdata -o app.exe .
! stderr 'compile.*hot.go'
go tool compile -p main -llvm-pgo=run.profdata -llvm-keep-ir -o check.o hot.go
grep '"branch_weights", i32 0, i32 100' check.o.opt.ll
exec ./app.exe reverse
stderr '^-5550$'

# Reject a CPU profile accidentally passed to LLVM.
! go tool compile -p main -llvm-pgo=cpu.pprof -o check.o hot.go
stderr 'profile|Profile'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/hot

go 1.26
-- hot.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func left(x int) int { return x + 3 }

//go:noinline
func right(x int) int { return x - 5 }

//go:noinline
func branch(x int) int {
	if x > 0 { return left(x) }
	return right(x)
}
-- main.go --
package main
import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "os"
)

func main() {
	// Include a FIPS package: the platform loader must be able to fix up
	// the profiling records even when package constants live in hashed text.
	if sha256.Sum256(nil)[0] != 0xe3 { panic("sha256") }
	sign := 1
	if len(os.Args) > 1 { sign = -1 }
	sum := 0
	for i := 1; i <= 100; i++ { sum += branch(i*sign) }
	println(sum)
}
